queue.name: IGAT 5 Gas Pipeline
queue.note: Roster has IGAT 1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11 but NO IGAT 5; distinct route South Pars/Jam -> Aghajari-Behbahan (Khuzestan), sour-gas injection function, 504 km / 56 in. No PID collision.

evidence.note: Lists IGAT-5 as an operating IGAT trunkline: 56 in (1,420 mm); transfers sour gas from South Pars phases 6,7,8 to Khuzestan for oil-well injection.
GIS dataset page: 504 km, 56 in IGAT-5 from South Pars Gas Complex (Jam, Bushehr) to Aghajari Gas Injection Compression Station (Behbahan, Khuzestan).

queue.name: Minab-Sirik-Kuhmobarak Gas Pipeline
queue.note: No roster row for Minab/Sirik/Kuhmobarak. Coastal Hormozgan trunkline (Minab-Sirik ~121 km/42 in commissioned, Sirik-Kuhmobarak section under way; ~200 km total) feeding off IGAT-7 (P0446). Distinct from P2225 Iran-Oman (Rudan->Sohar export leg); vetter to confirm it is not folded into P2225.

evidence.note: IGEDC acting head: completion of the 121 km, 42 in Minab-Sirik pipeline providing infrastructure to deliver gas to Kuh-e Mobarak and facilitate exports; commissioned Iranian year 1403 (ended Mar 20 2025).
200 km NIGC line in two sections: 120 km Minab-Sirik (~87% complete) plus Sirik-Kuhmobarak (began Feb 2023); connects to IGAT-7, South Pars supply, framed as enabling Oman exports.
Independent confirmation: 200 km Minab to Kuhmobarak on the Sea of Oman; first 120 km Minab-Sirik ~87% complete, second section started February; tied into IGAT-7.

queue.name: Laft-Gourzin-Bandar Abbas Gas Pipeline
queue.note: No roster row for Qeshm Island / Bandar Abbas-Laft-Gourzin. Dedicated 59 km / 30 in transmission line with a 3 km subsea Persian Gulf crossing (a first for Iran's gas industry); supplies Qeshm industries, power plants, residents. Not any IGAT trunk.

evidence.note: 59 km, 30 in transmission line with 3 km subsea crossing (70 m depth) Bandar Pol -> Bandar Laft on Qeshm; developer IGEDC; completed; first subsea crossing for Iran's gas industry.
NIGC/IGTC annual roundup lists Laft-Gourzin-Bandar Abbas among lines online in Iranian year 1403 (37 km commissioned, further expansion planned).

queue.name: Ardebil-Garmi Gas Pipeline
queue.note: No roster row for Ardebil-Garmi. 77 km / 24 in NW-Iran transmission line in northern Ardebil Province; reported by the TSO as transmission, not distribution. Separate from Rasht-Chelavend (P5984) and the Chelvand-Ardebil leg.

evidence.note: IGEDC: inauguration of the 77 km, 24 in Ardebil-Garmi pipeline, 'one of the province's most strategic projects'; commissioned Iranian year 1403.

queue.name: Dashtak-Nehbandan Gas Pipeline
queue.note: No roster row for Dashtak or Nehbandan. Part of Iran's eastern gas supply ring, explicitly a transmission line tied into the cross-country grid; links 160 industrial units incl. two cement plants.

evidence.note: Oil Minister Oji inaugurated 'a gas transmission line from Dashtak to Nehbandan' linking 160 industrial units to the cross-country gas network.
IGEDC: Dorahi Dashtak-Nehbandan pipeline contributes to completing the eastern gas supply ring and increases supply security in eastern/northeastern Iran.

queue.name: Iranshahr-Chabahar Gas Pipeline
queue.note: No roster row Iranshahr-Chabahar. Roster's only SE line is Zahedan-Zabol (P6028); this is a distinct southern grid extension toward Chabahar (possibly the '154 km southern Sistan-Baluchestan' line in 2025 IGEDC targets).

evidence.note: Oji inaugurated 'a gas transmission line from Iranshahr to Chabahar' to supply the Chabahar power plant; ~$500M invested across provincial projects.

queue.name: Chelvand-Ardebil Gas Pipeline
queue.note: Distinct from Rasht-Chelavend (P5984, operating): the onward Chelvand->Ardebil leg, under construction. No matching roster row.

evidence.note: Oil Ministry 2026 target list includes 'more than 50 km of the Chelvand-Ardebil pipeline' to be commissioned by late Mar 2026.

queue.name: Iran-UAE (Salman-Sharjah) Gas Pipeline
queue.note: Cross-border Iran->UAE export line (Salman field -> Sharjah, ~600 mmcfd, 30 in UAE-side): physically built, test-flowed 2010, never entered commercial service, now dormant/dead after arbitration. Not P3950 (Salman-Siri domestic) nor P3949; vetter to confirm not folded into P3174 (proposed offshore, 1500 km/1000 mmcfd) - different scope/direction.

evidence.note: 2001 NIOC-Crescent 25-yr deal to pipe Salman-field gas to Sharjah; NIOC test-flowed gas to Dana Gas' Sharjah facility in 2010 before leaks forced a halt; commercial supply never began.
Arbitration awarded Dana Gas/Crescent $607.5m; 2001 contract obliged NIOC to supply ~600 mmcfd from Salman field to Sharjah, deliveries due 2005/2008 but never made.

queue.name: Iran-Nakhchivan Gas Pipeline (Julfa)
queue.note: Operating cross-border delivery to the Nakhchivan exclave (gas handed off at Julfa) under a 2004 swap, from 2005, ~0.3-0.4 bcm/yr. Distinct direction from P0748 (Azerbaijan->Iran import at Astara) and P0449 (Iran-Armenia). CAVEAT: may run as a swap over existing IGAT/regional infrastructure rather than a dedicated new-build spur; physical specs unpinned - vetter to decide keep-vs-fold into P0748.

evidence.note: Azerbaijan-Iran 2004 20-yr agreement to supply Nakhchivan, implemented from 2005; ~350 mcm/yr with 15% deducted as transit fee; Iran carries gas across its territory to the exclave (no Azerbaijan land border).

queue.name: Qom-Mohammadieh-Parchin Gas Pipeline
queue.note: No roster row for Qom-Mohammadieh-Parchin. NIGC-listed high-pressure transmission line on the Qom-Tehran corridor. WEAKER lead: single 2021 source, no length/diameter, no second independent corroboration - vetter to confirm existence/specs.

evidence.note: NIGC lists Qom-Mohammadieh-Parchin among >1,700 km of high-pressure transmission lines then under construction; no length/diameter given.
